page.content:
1623 collected plays that saved Macbeth, The Tempest, and eighteen others.

How First Folio connects

  • Creator: William Shakespeare — The First Folio collects Shakespeare's plays after his death.
  • Work: Macbeth — The First Folio is the first printing of Macbeth.
  • Work: The Tempest — The First Folio is the first printing of The Tempest.
  • Character: Ben Jonson — Ben Jonson wrote the preface that frames the First Folio.

What is First Folio?

Mr. William Shakespeares Comedies, Histories, & Tragedies — the First Folio — is the 1623 volume Heminges and Condell printed, with a Jonson preface, that first gathered thirty-six plays and kept half of them from vanishing.

Key threads lead to William Shakespeare, Macbeth, The Tempest and Ben Jonson.
